## What to do next (your listed 3 commands)
Run these in order from your repo root:

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

### What each does (so you know what to expect)
1. **`aub_autopilot.py ... --select-best`**

2. **`system_autopilot.py ...`**
   - Runs system-level candidate specs (end-to-end configurations), potentially finding improvements that module-level tuning didn’t surface.

3. **`aub_next_fix.py ... --output ...next_fix.md`**
   - Produces a “next fix” report: typically a prioritized list of failing/weak areas and suggested adjustments to try next.

## Quick sanity checks if results look “stuck”
- Confirm the **objective direction** (minimize vs maximize) used by `--select-best`.
- Check whether **lockbox** is treated as a gating eval (often it is), meaning a candidate can look good on tuning_mean but fail lockbox constraints.
- Ensure the **registry/spec files** actually include new candidate generation (not just re-running the same space).
